concept: Review and integration: curiosity as an identity, not just an occasional mood
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across going deeper, exploring outside your comfort zone, and self-directed learning — what pattern do you notice about yourself?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real area of their life where more curiosity would change something

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
